P2-A-017.issue: CRITICAL — Authoring monologue embedded in Choice B text
P2-A-017.snippet_start: Normalized net profit margin is approximately 7.84%, exceeding the 7.0% hurdle. All four items are non-recurring in nature and should be adjusted... actually wait — no. Let me re-derive this carefully...
P2-A-017.description: Choice B contains the author's internal reasoning process including redrafts and abandoned arithmetic. The text 'Let me redesign Choice B with different numbers. Let gain = $2.0M instead...' is raw authoring content. The numeric conclusion in the choice text (7.84%) contradicts the ExplanationCorrect (6.73%), meaning the learner sees a wrong number in the choice text.

BUT Choice B text says 7.84% ABOVE hurdle. Self-contradicting.
